snippet.title: That Lonesome Valley gameplay (free gay cowboy romance game), first ~10 minutes
snippet.description:
I made a free short gay romance game / visual novel about walking, sheepherding, and cowboy kissing. Info + play in browser here: https://radiatoryang.itch.io/that-lonesome-valley 

The whole game is about 30 minutes long. This is just the first 10 minutes of gameplay -- what happens next?! Well, there's only one way to find out...
